findings: The methyl orange product is labelled 'p-dimethylaminoazo benzene' (the name of butter yellow) and drawn with N triple bond N; the lesson names it methyl orange with -N=N-.

The book calls the phenylamine nitrogen sp3 hybridised while also describing its lone pair as delocalised; the lesson reports the book's label. The Quick Check questions are printed without answers; the lesson's answers were derived for it and need the second-person review.
